notes:
Beta 1.0.7 - What's New

For lower-end PCs
I'm sorry, but I've also tested other N64 PC ports, and stuttering is an issue that affects them as well. The only thing I can recommend is using Medium/Low settings and 30 FPS to improve the situation.

Performance
Fixed two changes introduced in 1.0.5 that caused severe lag and stuttering on lower-end PCs. Performance has also improved on more powerful PCs.

Graphics
- The HALF TIME text now animates smoothly when disappearing as well (at 60 FPS or higher).
- Fixed the HOME/AWAY arrows on the pre-match screens: they didn't always appear in every game mode.

Kit Studio
Added a new button to the launcher that opens a quick kit editor for each team. You can customize shirts and sleeves (home, away, goalkeeper), numbers, and the captain's armband. Changes are saved directly to the team's folder, while the original version of each file is preserved in the "backup" folder. For now, the game doesn't automatically select Home/Away kits based on the colors of the modified kits.

World League
When starting a new World League, you can now choose the rules, including classic league rules that allow draws after 90 minutes, which is the default option. This setting is independent of Friendly and Mini League modes. Existing World Leagues will keep their original rules. This feature isn't fully complete yet: rules can still be changed after a league has started, but doing so may cause matches decided by penalty shootouts to be counted incorrectly in the standings. Still, it works.

Foul Replays
START now also skips foul replays (previously, it only worked for goal replays).

World Stars Flag
Fixed an issue where the Euro Stars flag was incorrectly displayed instead of the World Stars flag.
